quality_guards: Fatigue controls depend on shift pattern, workload, overtime, commuting, worker vulnerability, supervision, alertness and safety-critical consequences.
Shift-work evidence is organisation-, schedule- and worker-specific and is not an exact parcel-level incident probability.
Ventilation controls depend on room volume, occupancy, building layout, process heat, pollutants, openings, mechanical-system performance and weather.
Ventilation evidence is building-, room- and operating-condition-specific and is not an exact parcel-level indoor-air-risk probability.
Welding-fume controls depend on process, metal, coating, duration, location, enclosure, LEV capture, RPE fit and nearby-worker exposure.
Welding evidence is process-, material-, task- and worker-specific and is not an exact parcel-level cancer or asthma probability.
Wood-dust controls depend on wood species, composite material, machining process, dust generation, LEV performance, cleaning method and RPE use.
Wood-dust evidence is material-, process- and exposure-specific and is not an exact parcel-level respiratory or cancer probability.
Silica controls depend on material composition, tool energy, task duration, enclosure, water suppression, extraction performance, housekeeping and RPE fit.
Silica evidence is material-, task- and exposure-specific and is not an exact parcel-level lung-disease probability.
Demolition controls depend on structural form, condition, sequence, neighbouring assets, available space, services, asbestos, traffic and public exposure.
Demolition evidence is structure-, project- and site-specific and is not an exact parcel-level collapse or injury probability.
MEWP controls depend on machine type, ground, load, reach, overhead hazards, wind, traffic, rescue arrangements, operator competence and examination status.
MEWP evidence is equipment-, task-, site- and weather-specific and is not an exact parcel-level overturn or fall probability.
Waste controls depend on waste stream, contamination, sharps, plant, vehicles, public access, processing method, hygiene facilities and worker competence.
Waste and recycling evidence is material-, facility- and activity-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury or infection probability.
Port controls depend on cargo, vessels, shore-side roles, dangerous goods, traffic layout, lifting, quay edges, weather, access and emergency capability.
Ports evidence is operation-, cargo-, vessel- and site-specific and is not an exact parcel-level transport or major-incident probability.
Quarry controls depend on geology, faces, tips, lagoons, explosives, mobile plant, roads, competence, public access, weather and inspection findings.
Quarry evidence is site-, operation- and geological-condition-specific and is not an exact parcel-level collapse or transport probability.
Official-source context is not converted into an exact parcel-level probability.
